L70@P3: 5.0. Appearance
L71@P3:  There shall be no such defects as scratch, rust, discoloration, leakage which
L72@P3:  may adversely affect commercial value of the cell.
L73@P3: 6.0. Standard test conditions
L74@P3:  6.1 Environmental conditions
L75@P3:  Unless otherwise specified, all tests stated in this specification are conducted at
L76@P3: temperature 25±5℃ and humidity under 65%.
L77@P3:  6.2 Measuring equipments
L78@P3:  (1) Amp-meter and volt-meter
L79@P3:  The amp-meter and volt-meter should have an accuracy of the grade 0.5mA and
L80@P3: mV or higher.
L81@P3:  (2) Slide caliper
L82@P3:  The slide caliper should have 0.01 mm scale.
L83@P3:  (3) Impedance meter
L84@P3:  The impedance meter with AC 1 kHz should be used.
L85@P3: 7.0. Characteristics
L86@P3:  7.1 Standard charge
L87@P3:  This "Standard charge" means charging the cell CCCV with charge current 0.5CmA
L88@P3: (1,500mA), constant voltage 4.2V and 100mA cut-off in CV mode at 25℃ for capacity.
L89@P3: .
L90@P3: 7.2 Rated charge
L91@P3: Rated charge means charging the cell CCCV with charge current 4A and 100mA cut-off
L92@P3: at 25℃
L93@P3: 7.3 Standard discharge capacity
L94@P3:  The standard discharge capacity is the initial discharge capacity of the cell, which is
L95@P3: measured with discharge current of 600mA(0.2C) with 2.5V cut-off at 25℃ within 1hour
L96@P3: after the standard charge.
L97@P3:  Standard discharge capacity ≥ 3,000mAh
L98@P3: 7.4 Rated discharge capacity
L99@P3: The rated discharge is the discharge capacity of the cell, which is measured with
L100@P3: discharge current of 10A with 2.5V cut-off at 25℃ within 1hour after the rated charge.
L101@P3-4:  Standard rated discharge capacity ≥ 2,950mAh-SAMSUNG SDI Confidential Proprietary –

L147@P5: 8.0. Mechanical Characteristics
L148@P5:  8.1 Drop test
L149@P5: Test method: Fully rated charged Cells drop onto the concrete floor from 1.0m height
L150@P5: at a random direction 3 times. The cells or batteries are dropped so as to
L151@P5: obtain impacts in random orientations. After the test, the sample shall be
L152@P5: put on rest for a minimum of one hour and then a visual inspection shall
L153@P5: be performed.
L154@P5: 
L155@P5: Criteria: No fire, no explosion.
L156@P5: Drop test shall be performed with the IEC62133 standard
L157@P5: 8.2 Vibration test
L158@P5: Test method: As to the UN transportation regulation (UN38.3), for each axis (X and
L159@P5: Y axis with cylindrical cells) 7Hz→200Hz→7Hz for 15min, repetition
L160@P5: 12 times totally 3hours, the acceleration 1g during 7 to 18Hz and 8g
L161@P5: (amplitude 1.6mm) up to 200Hz.
L162@P5: Criteria: No leakage, with less than 10% of OCV drop
L163@P5: Vibration test shall be performed with the UN38.3 standard
L164@P5: 9.0. Safety
L165@P5:  9.1 Overcharge test
L166@P5: Test method: Cell is to be discharged at a constant current of 0.6A to 2.5V. The cell is
L167@P5: then to be charged with a 20V and 12A. Charging duration is to be 7h.
L168@P5: Criteria: No fire, and no explosion.
L169@P5-6: Overcharge test shall be performed with the UL1642 standard-SAMSUNG SDI Confidential Proprietary –
L170@P6: Spec. No. INR21700-30T Version No. 2.0
L171@P6: - 6/18 -
L172@P6:  9.2 External short-circuit test
L173@P6: Test method: Fully rated charged cell is to be short-circuited by connecting the positive
L174@P6: and negative terminals of the battery with a circuit load having a
L175@P6: resistance load of 80 ±20 mΩ The battery is to discharge until a fire or
L176@P6: explosion is obtained, or until it has reached a completely discharged
L177@P6: state of less than 0.2 V and the battery case temperature has returned to
L178@P6: ±10°C of ambient temperature. The return to near ambient of the battery
L179@P6: (cell) casing in an indication of ultimate results.
L180@P6:  Criteria: No fire, and no explosion
L181@P6: External short-circuit test shall be performed with the UL1642 standard
L182@P6:  9.3 Forced discharge test
L183@P6: Test method: A discharged cell is subjected to a reverse charge at 1.0C (3.0A)
L184@P6: for 90 min.
L185@P6:  Criteria: No fire, and no explosion.
L186@P6: Forced discharge test shall be performed with the IEC62133 standard
L187@P6: 9.4 Heating test
L188@P6:  Test method: To heat up the rated charged cell at heating rate 5℃ per minute up to
L189@P6:  130℃ and keep the cell in oven for 1 hour.
L190@P6:  Criteria: No fire, and no explosion.
L191@P6: 10.0. Warranty
L192@P6: Samsung SDI will be responsible for replacing the cell against defects or poor workmanship
L193@P6: for 15months from the date of shipping. Any other problem caused by malfunction of the
L194@P6: equipment or mix-use of the cell is not under this warranty.
L195@P6: The warranty set forth in proper using and handling conditions described above and
L196@P6: excludes in the case of a defect which is not related to manufacturing of the cell.
L197@P6: 
L198@P6: 11.0. Others
L199@P6:  11.1 Storage for a long time
L200@P6:  If the cell is kept for a long time (3 months or more), It is strongly recommended
L201@P6:  that the cell is preserved at dry and low-temperature.
L202@P6:  11.2 Others
L203@P6:  Any matters that specifications do not have, should be conferred with between the
L204@P6-7: both parties.-SAMSUNG SDI Confidential Proprietary –
L205@P7: Spec. No. INR21700-30T Version No. 2.0
L206@P7: - 7/18 -
L207@P7: Proper use and handling of lithium ion cells
L208@P7: See before using lithium-ion cell
L209@P7: Supplied by
L210@P7: Samsung SDI Co., Ltd.
L211@P7: 1.0. General
L212@P7:  This document has been prepared to describe the appropriate cautions and
L213@P7:  prohibitions, which the customer should take or employ when the customer uses
L214@P7: and handles the lithium ion cell to be manufactured and supplied by Samsung SDI Co.,
L215@P7: Ltd., in order to obtain optimal performance and safety.
L216@P7: 2.0. Charging
L217@P7:  2.1 Charging current
L218@P7:  Charging current shall be less than maximum charge current specified in the product
L219@P7: specification.
L220@P7:  2.2 Charging voltage
L221@P7:  Charging shall be done by voltage less than that specified in the product specification.
L222@P7:  2.3 Charging time
L223@P7:  Continuous charging under specified voltage does not cause any loss of performance
L224@P7: characteristics. However, the charge timer is recommended to be installed from a safety
L225@P7: consideration, which shuts off further charging at time specified in the product
L226@P7: specification.
L227@P7:  2.4 Charging temperature
L228@P7:  The cell shall be charged within a range of specified temperatures in the specification.
L229@P7:  2.5 Reverse charging
L230@P7:  The cell shall be connected, confirming that its poles are correctly aligned.
L231@P7:  Inverse charging shall be strictly prohibited. If the cell is connected improperly, it may be
L232@P7: damaged.
L233@P7: 3.0. Discharging
L234@P7:  3.1 Discharging
L235@P7:  3.1.1 The cell shall be discharged continuously at less than maximum discharge current
L236@P7:  specified in the product specification. In case of the higher discharge current
L237@P7: should be set, it shall be discussed together with SDI.
L238@P7:  3.2 Discharging temperature
L239@P7: 3.2.1 The cell shall be discharged within a range of temperatures specified in
L240@P7-8: the product specification.-SAMSUNG SDI Confidential Proprietary –
L241@P8: Spec. No. INR21700-30T Version No. 2.0
L242@P8: - 8/18 -
L243@P8: 3.2.2 Otherwise, it may cause loss of performance characteristics.
L244@P8:  3.3 Over-discharging
L245@P8:  3.3.1 The system should equip with a device to prevent further discharging
L246@P8:  exceeding discharging cut-off voltage specified in the product specification.
L247@P8:  3.3.2 Over-discharging may cause loss of performance characteristics of battery.
L248@P8:  3.3.3 Over-discharging may occur by self-discharge if the battery is left for
L249@P8:  a very long time without any use.
L250@P8:  3.3.4 The charger should equip with a device to detect voltage of cell block and to
L251@P8:  determine recharging procedures.
L252@P8: 4.0. Storage
L253@P8: 4.1 Storage conditions
L254@P8:  4.1.1 The cell should be stored within a range of temperatures specified
L255@P8:  in the product specification.
L256@P8:  4.1.2 Otherwise, it may cause loss of performance characteristics, leakage and/or rust.
L257@P8:  4.2 Long-term storage
L258@P8:  4.2.1 The cell should be used within a short period after charging because
L259@P8:  long-term storage may cause loss of capacity by self-discharging.
L260@P8:  4.2.2. If long-term storage is necessary, the cell should be stored at lower
L261@P8:  voltage within a range specified in the product specification, because
L262@P8:  storage with higher voltage may cause more loss of performance characteristics.
L263@P8: 5.0. Cycle life
L264@P8:  5.1 Cycle life performance
L265@P8:  5.1.1 The cell can be charged/discharged repeatedly up to times specified in
L266@P8:  the product specification with a certain level of capacity specified in the
L267@P8: product specification.
L268@P8:  5.1.2 Cycle life may be determined by conditions of charging, discharging,
L269@P8:  operating temperature and/or storage.
L270@P8: 6.0. Design of system
L271@P8:  6.1 Connection between the cell and the battery
L272@P8:  6.1.1 The cell should not be soldered directly with other cells. Namely, the cell
L273@P8:  should be welded with leads on its terminal and then be soldered with
L274@P8:  wire or leads to solder.
L275@P8:  6.1.2 Otherwise, it may cause damage of component, such as separator and
L276@P8-9:  insulator, by heat generation.-SAMSUNG SDI Confidential Proprietary –
L277@P9: Spec. No. INR21700-30T Version No. 2.0
L278@P9: - 9/18 -
L279@P9:  6.2 Positioning the battery in the system
L280@P9:  6.2.1 The battery should be positioned as possible as far from heat sources
L281@P9:  and high temperature components.
L282@P9:  6.2.2 Otherwise, it may cause loss of characteristics.
L283@P9:  6.2.3 The recommended spacing between the cells is more than 1mm.
L284@P9:  6.3 Mechanical shock protection of the battery
L285@P9:  6.3.1 The battery should be equipped with appropriate shock absorbers in the pack
L286@P9: in order to minimize shock, which can damage the cells.
L287@P9:  6.3.2 Otherwise, it may cause shape distortion, leakage, heat generation
L288@P9:  and/or rupture and/or open circuit.
L289@P9:  6.4 Short-circuit protection of the cell
L290@P9:  6.4.1 The cell equips with an insulating sleeve to protect short-circuit which
L291@P9:  may occur during transportation, battery assembly and /or system operation.
L292@P9:  6.4.2 If the cell sleeve is damaged by some cause such as outside impact,
L293@P9:  it may cause short-circuit with some wiring inside the battery.
L294@P9:  6.5 Connection between the battery and charger/system
L295@P9:  6.5.1 The battery should be designed to be connected only to the specified
L296@P9:  charger and system.
L297@P9:  6.5.2 A reverse connection of the battery, even in the specified system,
L298@P9:  should be avoided by employing special battery design such as
L299@P9: a special terminals.
L300@P9: 6.6 Pack design
L301@P9:  6.6.1 The current consumption of the battery pack should be under 10uA
L302@P9: at sleep mode.
L303@P9: 6.6.2 Cell voltage monitoring system.
L304@P9: The system (charger or pack) should be equipped with a device to monitor each
L305@P9: voltage of cell block to avoid cell imbalance which can cause damage to the cells.
L306@P9: 6.6.3 The battery pack or system should have warning system such as over temperature,
L307@P9: over voltage, over current, and so on.
L308@P9: 7.0. Battery pack assembly
L309@P9:  7.1 Prohibition of usage of damaged cell
L310@P9:  7.1.1 The cell should be inspected visually before battery assembly.
L311@P9:  7.1.2 The cell should not be used if sleeve-damage, can-distorsion and/or
L312@P9:  electrolyte-smell is detected.
L313@P9:  7.2 Terminals handling
L314@P9:  7.2.1 Excessive force on the negative terminal should be avoided when
L315@P9:  external strip terminal is welled.
L316@P9:  7.3 Transportation
L317@P9:  7.3.1 If the cell is necessary to be transported to such as the battery manufacturer,
L318@P9-10: careful precautions should be taken to avoid damage of cell.-SAMSUNG SDI Confidential Proprietary –
L319@P10: Spec. No. INR21700-30T Version No. 2.0
L320@P10: - 10/18 -
L321@P10: 8.0. Others
L322@P10:  8.1 Disassembly
L323@P10:  8.1.1 The cell should not be dismantled from the battery pack.
L324@P10:  8.1.2 Internal short-circuit caused by disassembly may lead to heat generation
L325@P10:  and/or venting.
L326@P10:  8.1.3 When the electrolyte is coming in contact with the skin or eyes,
L327@P10:  flush immediately with fresh water and seek medical advice.
L328@P10:  8.2 Short-circuiting
L329@P10:  8.2.1 Short-circuit results in very high current which leads to heat generation.
L330@P10:  8.2.2 An appropriate circuitry should be employed to protect accidental
L331@P10:  short-circuiting.
L332@P10: 8.3 Incineration
L333@P10:  8.3.1 Incinerating and disposing of the cell in fire are strictly prohibited,
L334@P10:  because it may cause rupture and explosion.
L335@P10:  8.4 Immersion
L336@P10:  8.4.1 Soaking the cell in water is strictly prohibited, because it may cause
L337@P10:  corrosion and leakage of components to be damaged to functions
L338@P10:  8.5 Mixing use
L339@P10:  8.5.1 Different types of cell, or same types but different cell manufacturer's shall not be
L340@P10: used, which may lead to cell imbalance, cell rupture or damage to system due to
L341@P10: the different characteristics of cell.
L342@P10:  8.6 Battery exchange
L343@P10:  8.6.1 Although the cell contains no environmentally hazardous component,
L344@P10:  such as lead or cadmium, the battery shall be disposed according to
L345@P10:  the local regulations when it is disposed.
L346@P10:  8.6.2 The cell should be disposed with a discharged state to avoid heat generation
L347@P10: by an inadvertent short-circuit.
L348@P10: 8.7 Caution
L349@P10: The Battery used in this device may present a risk of fire or chemical burn if
L350@P10: mistreated.
L351@P10: Do not disassemble, expose to heat above 100℃ or incinerate it.
L352@P10: Replace battery with those of Samsung SDI only.
L353@P10: Use of another battery may cause a risk of fire or explosion.
L354@P10: Dispose of used battery promptly.
L355@P10: Keep battery away from children.
L356@P10: Do not disassemble and do not dispose of battery in fire.
L357@P10-11: 8.8 Warning – Attached-SAMSUNG SDI Confidential Proprietary –

L443@P13: - 13/18 -
L444@P13: Handling precaution and prohibitions of lithium Ion rechargeable cells and
L445@P13: batteries
L446@P13: Inaccurate handling of lithium ion and lithium ion polymer rechargeable battery may cause leakage, heat,
L447@P13: smoke, an explosion, or fire.
L448@P13:  This could cause deterioration of performance or failure. Please be sure to follow instructions carefully.
L449@P13: 1.1 Storage
L475@P14: Spec. No. INR21700-30T Version No. 2.0
L476@P14: - 14/18 -
L482@P14: Don't use or assemble the battery with other makers' batteries, different types and/or models of
L483@P14: batteries such as dry batteries, nickel-metal hydride batteries, or nickel-cadmium batteries.
L484@P14:  Don't use or assemble old and new batteries together.
L485@P14:  [ Warning! ]
L486@P14:  Stop charging the battery if charging isn't completed within the specified time.
